title: Help articles, the changelog and the naming and voice canons carry the ladder
detail: PHASE 6 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). content/help/spaces/plans-and-pricing.md (Every plan can sell; the expired October 1 date), get-paid.md, billing.md, membership and Journey articles, practices.md and programs-and-chapters.md checked against live gates, a new Collective article, a Crew article, a CHANGELOG entry, docs/NAMING.md (Collective no longer retired) and docs/CONTENT-VOICE.md section 1a. pnpm check:help passes.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const h=r("content/help/spaces/plans-and-pricing.md");if(/Every plan can sell/i.test(h))fail("help still says every plan can sell");if(/October 1, 2026/.test(h))fail("help still carries the expired October 1 date");if(!fs.existsSync("content/help/spaces/collective.md"))fail("no Collective help article");if(!/five-tier|five tiers/i.test(r("docs/CHANGELOG.md")))fail("no changelog entry");if(/Collective[^.\n]{0,80}retired/i.test(r("docs/NAMING.md")))fail("NAMING.md still retires Collective");console.log("ok: help and canons carry the ladder")'
